_note: The abandoned campsite (M9.2; DESIGN.md "Abandoned campsite", agreed with Aaron in Session 15). Positions are in the campsite's own frame: from where the path from home enters the clearing, x metres to your right as you walk in, z metres ahead (the clearing's centre is z 0; the entrance is z = -radius). yaw: degrees, turning from facing ahead toward your right. car: the campers' car (vehicles.json types; the campsite's placement gives it a sure battery and no alarm), parked at the edge by the path. tents: kind a (an A-frame) or dome; slashed: torn open from the inside, the slit on its far side (found, not presented). searches: the hold-X search points, in the order a player meets them walking in: guaranteed items (camcorder: the lore item; shotgun: the gun, with `rounds` more shells; or a loot.json item with amount) and a rolled table (loot.json items, each rolled on its own). The camcorder is near the entrance and the shotgun deep in the camp (the order guarantee). props: set dressing (chairs, packs, the fire ring, blood, the stick figures hung in the trees, the ritual marks cut into trunks at the edge). wave: the zombies that burst from the treeline when the shotgun is taken: count, the spread of their arrival (seconds), and where they come from (arcs of the clearing's edge, in degrees in the campsite frame: 0 ahead, 90 to the right, -90 to the left; distance past the edge).
